sealNote: Sealed before any tuning or model comparison. Unsealing requires a recorded decision with reason; the test split below is never inspected before the pre-registered final run (T045).
partitionRule: Repository-plus-time: no source repository and no commit date may appear in more than one of train/tune/test. Public-benchmark instances default to tune at most; test holds authored tasks plus a minority of benchmark instances selected after the seal date.

train.purpose: Feature discovery and shortlist exploration only

example.purpose: Documentation fixtures excluded from every run

contaminationNotes: Public instances may appear in model training data; weight authored held-out tasks highest. Re-verify per-instance source licenses at selection time: harness licenses do not cover every upstream task repository.
